title: [CQ-R11] Isolated check lifecycle
description:
Objective: Run candidate code under separate unprivileged identities in fresh check environments.

Deliverable: Isolated check lifecycle. This is task R11 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): R09, V02.
definitionOfDone: Candidate jobs cannot read supervisor credentials or mutate protected definitions.
Network/resource/process/filesystem boundaries are reported and enforced.
Environment identity changes require new evidence.
Fresh verification `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
reopenReason: Governor feed rule (2026-10-29): CQ row whose only unmet prerequisite, CQ-R09 (task-0dd1cce2), has an approved plan (WORKING, 5 steps). 23a5563c is already met. Plan against R09's approved plan and the R09b/R09c landed code where it exists (R09c completion efffad6; R09b is in rework), and otherwise against the prerequisite's description, DoD and docs/plans/2026-10-24-ai-code-quality-and-context.md. Name every assumed interface in planningNotes and keep dependsOn. If a contract must be designed first, split it out (SPIDR) rather than report_blocked. CQ-V03 (task-9cc13170, PLANNING) consumes this row.

comments.content:
Interface request from the CQ-V04 split (2026-10-29). CQ-V04b (task-340a07b33a764c65b2486d16b30d7aef), the runner's focused check dispatch client, builds directly on this orchestrator. When you plan it, please expose two seams, or say in the plan which slice owns them.

1. Environment before the run. V04b must record moe.record_check_dispatch first, and that call pins `environment`; the observation must then carry the same value (CQ-V03b, CHECK_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH). So V04b needs the R11d checkEnvironment identity of the booted VM (its observed providerImageHash, the supervisor sha256 and its resources) BEFORE runCheckSession. One option is an onReady(environment) hook that may abort, placed after waitForGuestReady and materializeSnapshot and before the session.

2. Post-run workspace integrity, before the VM is deleted. After a session resolves 'passed', confirm that every materialized snapshot file still has its exact bytes, for example through R09 final's export mode compared with workspaceEntries(snapshot). Any change reports 'inconclusive'. New untracked files may stay allowed, as the host gate allows them. This is the VM half of CQ-V04 DoD 2 ("exit 0 followed by tree mutation is not a passing trusted result"); R11b's protected-path recheck covers only the protected files.
